confirmation_policy: All Train is known development evidence, including preceding06/07. No independent OOS or Historical Valid. Primary2011-2015=EX2016; legacy POOLED includes2016 partial and is also a fixed gate. Both must pass; full-year improvement count excludes2016.

feature_definitions.StockMom60_raw: Exact existing primitive: raw_return-beta*TOPIX, segment shift1, 60 observation sum min60; gap>20 exchange-date ordinal reset.
feature_definitions.Sector33Common_raw: Same as DM-20261002-07: signal-date PIT33 mean of finite StockMom60 including own, minimum5 finite members. Exact Date/Code join projected to present raw_return rows. Unknown/missing sector excluded.
feature_definitions.state: A stock>0/common>0; B stock>0/common<0; C stock<0/common>0; D stock<0/common<0. Exact zero or nonfinite -> ZERO_OR_MISSING. Context coverage=both raw values finite, includes defined zeros; four-state coverage reported separately.
feature_definitions.SECTOR_CONFIRM: Keep StockMom raw for A/D, else0 (including exact zeros or nonfinite). One EWMA(.25) of this raw score; no ranking before EWMA.
feature_definitions.SHORT_DISAGREE_VETO: If both raw values finite, keep StockMom>=0 and StockMom<0/common<=0, neutral0 only StockMom<0/common>0. Nonfinite raw context neutral0. Exact sector zero retains finite negative StockMom per requested <=0 branch. One EWMA(.25), no prior rank.
feature_definitions.EWMA: Unchanged existing per-Code/relisting segment alpha=.25 adjust=False smooth; sector change preserves Code state. Neutral0 before EWMA, reset only original gap rule.
feature_definitions.order: Operational context-adjusted strategy vs fixed rank-before-EWMA MOM60; NOT pure isolated context effect. No order-matched third candidate.

model: Two fixed non-fitted context rules, no second alpha or regression fit
selection_rule: All feasibility gates AND pooled/ex2016 NetSR>MOM60,2011-2015 NetSR improvements>=4/5,paired20day2000rep bootstrap deltaNetSR lower>0,annualNet>MOM60,turnover<=1.25*MOM60,Shortgross/net>=MOM60,Longnet>0,Qmonotonicity>0. B additionally deltaShortnet>0 and deltaShortgross/deltaShortnet>=.5. Failure=REJECT; no rescue.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block percentile95% on concatenated matched eligible sessions

diagnostics.attribution: A/B/C/D/ZERO_OR_MISSING row count, row-weighted and equal-date target mean, rawStock and each strategy RankIC, original official-book long/short gross/net/turn/cost. Sum components to daily book, no standalone state strategies.
diagnostics.states: All-history adjacent exchange-session transitions, summarize eligible destination dates; full contiguous spell lengths intersecting evaluation, gap resets, left/right censor flags; 1 and5 session uninterrupted persistence conditional on observable contiguous future5 (diagnostics only); C duration quantiles/distribution.
diagnostics.portfolio: Daily turnover/cost/side costs, rank autocorrelation/quintile retention/tail spells/percentile change from unchanged diagnostic functions. Turnover on current-state rows and transitions, C entry/exit share incl per-side. Immediate row-based descriptive attribution, not causal total.
diagnostics.replacement: B vs MOM60 official Short (Q1/Q2),Q1,Q2 membership removed/added/unchanged daily; save stock-day rows, target means, gross contribution, sector and stock/common distributions. DeltaShortgross=avoided removed losses+added returns+unchanged weight effect; deltaNet=deltaGross-deltaCost exact. C removed cohort separately; raw-veto not guaranteed actual Short exit due EWMA/global ranks.
diagnostics.long: All strategies long gross/net/turnover; daily long set intersection/Jaccard/retention vs MOM60.
diagnostics.concentration: PIT33 official Short exposure,HHI,max share,Q1/Q2 sector distributions,sector side gross/net/cost and top2 short/total contributions. No sector exclusion.
